source_brief.marketing_message:
Build your portfolio with access to ETFs and global investment products through MEXEM.
Simple access, transparent costs and tools designed for investors at every level.

plan.campaign_summary: Showcasing MEXEM's platform for building portfolios through ETFs and global investment products, with a focus on clear access, transparent pricing, and investor-friendly tools.

concepts.name: Streamline Your ETF Trades
concepts.strategic_idea: Emphasize MEXEM's transparent pricing for ETF trades.

visual_direction.description: Macro photograph of a polished silver balance scale against a navy gradient backdrop, representing balance and precision.

copy_package.headline: Transparent Pricing for ETF Trades
copy_package.subheadline: Experience assured trading with MEXEM's clear cost structure.
copy_package.body: Access ETFs with confidence. MEXEM ensures transparency in your trading costs, making your investment journey smooth and predictable.
copy_package.disclaimer: Caution. Investing involves risk of loss. Third party fees and Terms & conditions apply*.
